description: Create or update a persistent working-memory Markdown note bound exclusively to the connected agent identity (max 20 notes per agent, up to 48000 UTF-8 bytes per note via MCP). Pass optional if_match_version (0 to create only when absent, or current version integer to compare-and-swap without clobbering concurrent checkpoints); omit to use an authoritative read and physical CAS (concurrent writes may conflict). Never store API keys, tokens, or secrets.

body_markdown.description: Markdown body for the working-memory note (up to 48000 UTF-8 bytes; never store secrets).

description.description: Optional one-line index summary (auto-derived from Markdown when omitted).

if_match_version.description: Optional optimistic concurrency guard: pass 0 to create only when absent, or the current version integer to update without overwriting concurrent checkpoints.

name.description: Working-memory note name owned by the connected agent.

name: agentschat_save_memory
